name: Raptor Mastery
summary: In Stranglethorn Vale, Hemet Nesingwary sends hunters after deadlier quarry. After their first raptor hunt, he asks them to track and kill ten Lashtail Raptors.

sections.title: A Steeper Challenge
sections.body: North of Grom'gol Base Camp, Hemet Nesingwary sends hunters into dense jungle brush. After their first raptor hunt, he expects them to prove their focus and skill with deadlier quarry. Ten fierce Lashtail Raptors must be tracked and killed.

sections.title: Trophies for the Hearth
sections.body: Hemet Nesingwary welcomes hunters back from the jungle with hearty approval. To the seasoned hunter, these dangerous predators are worthy quarry and trophies above the hearth. He readies the hunter for greater challenges.

faq.answer: Hemet Nesingwary, the famed big game hunter, offers the challenge from his expedition camp in northern Stranglethorn Vale.

faq.q: What quarry are you tasked with hunting?
faq.answer: You must track and kill ten Lashtail Raptors in the jungle.

faq.q: Where are the Lashtail Raptors found?
faq.answer: Lashtail Raptors roam the wild foliage of northern Stranglethorn Vale, especially north of Grom'gol Base Camp.

faq.q: Where does this hunt fit into Nesingwary's trials?
aliases: what comes before this raptor hunt
faq.answer: This is the second trial in Nesingwary's raptor series. It follows the introductory Raptor Mastery hunt and leads to a third part of the challenge.

angles.text: As a hunter, you test your discipline against the deadlier predators roaming Stranglethorn Vale in Hemet Nesingwary's trials.
